name: Calc
summary: Evaluate arithmetic with variables, a line at a time.
description: Adds a Calculate permission and an eval command. Type `/calc 2 * (3 + 4)`, or write a `calc` code block with one expression or `name = expression` per line and press Run. Supports + - * / % ^, parentheses, pi, e, ans, and sqrt, abs, round, floor, ceil, min, max, ln, log10, sign. Output is plain text and the same input always gives the same answer.

changes: An overflow inside an expression is now an error instead of a quiet wrong number.

author: slim-m

permissions.name: Calculate
permissions.description: Evaluate arithmetic expressions in this space.

extension_points.name: eval
extension_points.description: Evaluate the given expressions, one per line.
